terminal_distribution_balance: Orthogonal rotated assignment: every terminal-count/layer block contains each distribution once; each obstacle mode is paired with all distributions across blocks.
feasibility_selection: Accept the first candidate in each predeclared terminal-count/layer/obstacle stratum that the exact oracle reports optimal; retain every attempted seed and rejection in candidate_manifest.jsonl. Selection does not inspect either router.
negative_control_rule: Place a fully blocked row across every layer and select terminals on both sides; accept only when the exact oracle proves infeasible.
execution_order: warmup input then nearest; alternate strategy order by measured repetition
zero_optimum_rule: relative gap is null; absolute gap and route success remain recorded
failure_rule: Failed routes receive no physical cost or optimality gap and are counted separately.
paired_significance: Layout is the unit; bootstrap paired mean-gap CI and exact two-sided sign test.
runtime_rule: Record router-internal and process wall times; summarize repetitions within layout; report within-layout repeat spread and treat microsecond-scale timing as descriptive.
no_tuning: No held-out case may be used to change terminal ordering, tie-breaking, search settings, or routing parameters.
